Verified skill archive acquisition; Both alternatives supply candidate bytes to the existing CLI process. inspectArchive parses and verifies them in memory before destination installation; this observation creates no persistent archive cache placement.; Dry-run performs no archive acquisition or verification and cannot be shown following either acquisition edge as completed work.; MOD-019 remains the IF-006 contract provider and MOD-014 the contributing installer. Physical execution participation does not transfer Interface ownership or Function allocation.; No remote archive was accessed and no local ZIP was read or installed for this architecture task. Asset distribution and agent-host skill execution remain separately qualified concerns.

Source address: https://github.com/xiongxianfei/rigorloop/releases/download/{release}/rigorloop-adapter-{target}-{release}.zip; Real installation without --from-archive loads and verifies package-bundled metadata, selects the compatible target/release, validates the exact official initial URL, and fetches those archive bytes.; The address is a source-declared template. It does not establish current release availability, deployed artifact identity, every redirect/proxy hop, or network/platform qualification.

Source address: <explicit --from-archive path>; Real installation with --from-archive resolves the explicitly supplied archive from the invoking working-directory context and checks its name/release against trusted bundled metadata before inspecting bytes.; The supplied ZIP is an alternative source of bytes, not a substitute metadata trust root. It is not automatically linked to this repository's candidate output placement.
